author: VivekGRamaswamy
text: This is a phenomenal opportunity & I’ll commit to making it a success for Ohio and for America. We’re the birthplace of aviation and we’re perfectly positioned to serve as home of the U.S. Space Force Academy. Major impact to the greater Dayton area, which launched the Wright Brothers into the skies and already serves the Wright-Patterson base. New York, Maryland, & Colorado each see $1 billion in benefits from their Academies. Let’s make it happen in Ohio. 💪🏼 🚀
